input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there (scheduled routine)
errors: Pool.map under multiprocessing hung on the first full experiment run (forked workers with threaded BLAS); fixed with single-thread env vars and ProcessPoolExecutor, cost ~25 min.
A second run lost ~11 min of baseline results to a TypeError (generator in json.dump) because raw results were only saved at the end.

doc_friction.issue: The hand-off says check_md_links/research_live_links exist but not that the Crossref API is unreachable from cloud sessions, so 'every citation is checked' (prompt-0.md) cannot be met; I labelled citations as taken from PROJECTS.md.

Track 14 asks for RL per design and CadQuery STLs; neither is cheap in a CPU-only run (CadQuery not installed). I used grid-plus-refine force search and a hand-written prism STL and said so in the README.

deviations.why: Milestone 1 names RL, CadQuery and YCB-like objects; I used a one-parameter policy search, a prism STL writer and three primitive shapes to finish in one run, and labelled all three in Limitations.

notes: Result is null/negative by design of honest reporting: the task saturates (all methods ~0.95 on test), the agent's best drops to 0.81 on 100 fresh scenes. Added the codesign theme to the homepage template.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: simulator + 3 baselines + problem design + README for a PhD-level researcher

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
